reader.reads: Every original formula and both theses; the scans of all four places, including both pages of III p349, and the enlarged corrected lines.

images.note: The enlarged line reads «erst als empfindendes Wesen bey uns legitimirt haben».
The enlarged Latin reads «Post ipsum, auxilio subeuntem ac tela ferentem corripiunt.»
The enlarged lines read «erfodert», «Charakters sey. Dieses kann auf zweyerley Weise seyn.» and «Freyheit».
The enlarged lines read «Beyspiel», «Karthaginienser», «Bewußtseyn» and «dem zweyten bloß als ein ästhetisch großer Gegenstand».

summary: The four conceptions are borne by their places in both languages, and the pages agree with the packet. The left relation joins suffering and dignity beyond what these passages explicitly state.
